answer: One defense is conductance-priced admission. Picture the trust graph as a mesa: the honest core camps on top, and every newcomer climbs from below. The toll is priced by conductance — the density of genuine links between newcomer and mesa top. A real person vouched by several unrelated members pays a toll in jade tokens. A Sybil farm looks like a quartz vein of shiny, isolated nodes, so each puppet's toll is set steep. The attacker pays N steep tolls or spends months forging real ties per puppet — no bulk discount. Honest users pay once; forged introductions burn the introducer's deposit too.
